soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, head capsule exceptionally long, lateral margins nearly parallel. Frontal peaks almost not raised. Labrum lanceolate, apex bluntly rounded, bearing two apical setae. Mandibles strong, apex strongly curved; antennae 14–15 segments. Postmentum very long. Anterior margin of the pronotum rather deeply incised in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight; about 8 long setae in the middle region.
